{{Quote|Shadows Six, Seven, and Ten were caught in the ray.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="som" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Shadow Ten'''." Flying a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] embarked on a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|mission]] with his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] to prevent the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] from destroying the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. Led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had devised a plan to destroy the ''Malevolence'', the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the squadron piloted their [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], arriving at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] just as the Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''Malevolence'', ordered one of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to fire at the nearing Republic squadrons. Shadow Ten's starfighter was disabled by the blast, leaving him and two other clone troopers floating in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] while the remains of the squadron continued toward the ''Malevolence'', eventually crippling its ion weapons.

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Ten first appeared "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]]. Shadow Ten was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers in the show.<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
